title: 第19章 突破灵纹八重武道大会开始第20章 决赛第一场一剑破旋龟
content_zh:
第19章突破灵纹八重，武道大会开始
“我也反对！”
“我不同意！”
大长老身边，有不少心腹。
这些年，大长老羽翼渐丰，逐渐能够与宗主华阳抗衡了。
华阳脸色不变，当然知道大长老不会同意。
不过，此事，由不得他！
“大长老既然不同意，那么，你认为，谁来做圣子更加合适？”
华阳淡淡道。
大长老面色沉凝：“暂时没有合适人选，那就空着，林尘残杀同门，性情暴戾，不适合做圣子！”
大长老心中有数，武极宗年轻一辈，现在没有人能与林尘争锋。
除了林尘之外，其他弟子，根本就没可能成为圣子。
“圣子之位，不能空缺。”
“至于大长老所说，林尘性情暴戾，更是无稽之谈，皇甫逸欲杀他，林尘难道要任他宰杀？”
“此事，长老会早就讨论过，林尘无罪，大长老不必再提。”
华阳语气冷厉，咄咄逼人。
在其身边，有不少心腹长老附和。
“林尘实力虽强，但没有武魂，如何能做圣子？圣子之位，更重要的是天赋，而非现在的实力。”
大长老话锋一转，嘴角露出一抹冷笑。
“谁说林尘没有未来，剑道之路，亦是一条光明大道，大长老若是不服，叫几个你看重的弟子来，与林尘切磋一番就是。”

华阳淡淡一笑。
大长老不说话了，真要切磋，无非就是找虐而已，他座下的几个弟子，不可能是林尘的对手。
“若没有人，那就不用浪费时间了。”
华阳一言而决，立林尘为圣子。
大长老拂袖而去。
册封仪式很快结束，武极宗圣子，地位崇高，享受宗门最好的资源待遇。
林尘对圣子之位，原本不感兴趣，无意争夺。
但，华阳看重，非要立他为圣子，他只好接受。
“林尘，你随我来。”
仪式结束之后，华阳招了招手，带林尘来到一间内室当中。
随后，华阳取出了一个玉瓶。
玉瓶当中，赫然有一滴淡金色的鲜血，散发出一股龙威。
蛟龙血！
“此物，比你上次会武得到的奖励更好一些，希望对你有用吧。”
华阳微笑。
林尘抱了抱拳，道谢。
content_en:
Chapter 19 Breaking through the eighth level of spiritual patterns, the martial arts conference begins
"I object too!"
"I don't agree!"
There are many confidants around the great elder.
Over the years, the great elder has become more and more powerful, and is gradually able to compete with the sect leader Huayang.
Huayang's expression remained unchanged, of course he knew that the great elder would not agree.
However, this matter is not up to him!
"Since the Great Elder disagrees, then, who do you think is more suitable to be the Holy Son?"
Huayang said lightly.
The Great Elder's face was solemn: "There is no suitable candidate for the moment, so it will be vacant. Lin Chen kills fellow disciples and has a violent temper. He is not suitable to be the Holy Son!"
The Great Elder knew that among the younger generation of Wuji Sect, no one could compete with Lin Chen.
Except for Lin Chen, it is impossible for other disciples to become the Holy Son.
"The position of the Holy Son cannot be vacant."
"As for what the Great Elder said, Lin Chen has a violent temper, which is even more nonsense. Huangfu Yi wants to kill him, should Lin Chen let him kill him?"
"This matter has been discussed by the Council of Elders a long time ago. Lin Chen is not guilty. The Great Elder does not need to mention it again."
Huayang's tone was cold and aggressive.
Around him, there were many close elders who agreed.
"Although Lin Chen is strong, how can he be the Holy Son without a martial spirit? The position of the Holy Son is more important because of his talent, rather than his current strength."
The great elder changed the topic and revealed a sneer on his lips.
"Who said Lin Chen has no future? The path of swordsmanship is also a bright road. If the Great Elder is not convinced, just call a few of your valued disciples to come and have a discussion with Lin Chen."
Huayang smiled faintly.
The Great Elder stopped talking. If they really wanted to spar, it would be nothing more than looking for abuse. The few disciples under him could not be Lin Chen's opponents.
"If there is no one, then there is no need to waste time."
Huayang decided with one word and made Lin Chen his holy son.
The great elder walked away.
The canonization ceremony ended soon. The holy son of Wuji Sect had a high status and enjoyed the best resources and treatment from the sect.
Lin Chen was originally not interested in the position of the Holy Son and had no intention of competing for it.
However, Huayang valued him and insisted on making him his holy son, so he had no choice but to accept it.
"Lin Chen, come with me."
After the ceremony, Hua Yang waved and led Lin Chen to an inner room.
Later, Huayang took out a jade bottle.
In the jade bottle, there was a drop of pale golden blood, exuding a dragon's power.
Dragon blood!
"This item is better than the reward you got from the last martial arts competition. I hope it will be useful to you."
Huayang smiled.
Lin Chen hugged his fists and thanked him.
